headlines.title: Baltic Dry Index at 3-Week High
headlines.content_summary: The Baltic Exchange’s dry bulk freight index, which monitors rates for ships carrying dry bulk commodities, adavanced for a fourth straight session on Tuesday, rising about 3.3% to a three-week high of 2,936 points. headlines.title: HMM, 동아프리카 서비스 개설

headlines.title: 한전, 다시 물가안정 혼자 짊어지나…2분기 영업익 악화 전망

headlines.title: 코스피 장초반 급등…매수 사이드카 발동
